text: dsh-plugins-hub 是面向 DSH 网页端的插件管理插件，会在“设置 → 插件”中加入第三方插件标签页。它通过宿主 webServer 路由读取 profile 和 loader 信息，将插件分为官方与第三方，并展示来源、版本、运行状态和更新状态。用户可以检查 npm 或 Git 插件更新、更新或卸载第三方插件、切换插件启停状态，也能打开插件目录并查看最近操作输出。启停会写入 profile 补丁层，更新和卸载需要重启 dsh web 才完全生效。适合希望在设置中管理已装插件的 DSH 网页用户；更新检查会访问 npm registry 或 GitHub，不需要 API key。

dsh-plugins-hub adds a third-party tab to DSH web Settings → Plugins. It groups plugins and shows source, version, runtime, and update status. Users can check updates, update or uninstall plugins, toggle them, open folders, view logs. Update checks contact npm or GitHub; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 设置页里看清哪些插件是自己装的。
我想从网页界面检查插件有没有新版本并更新它。
I want to enable or disable an installed DSH plugin from its settings page.
dsh-plugins-hub 的功能「插件清单」：在设置的第三方插件标签页展示官方与第三方插件分组，以及来源、版本、运行状态和更新状态。打开该标签页后读取当前 profile 与 loader 清单。
dsh-plugins-hub 的功能「插件生命周期管理」：在插件行操作中检查更新、更新或卸载第三方插件，并启用或停用插件。启停写入 profile 补丁层；更新和卸载会更新 profile 依赖并提示重启。
dsh-plugins-hub 使用更新检查时，会向 registry.npmjs.org 查询包版本，或向 GitHub 查询 Git 来源的远端提交；npm registry 可由 DSH_HUB_REGISTRY 指定。

dsh-plugins-hub README · dsh-plugins-hub：在 **设置 → 插件** 里把「官方插件」和「第三方插件」分开，并管理第三方插件：检查更新、更新、卸载、启用/停用。

```
设置 → 插件
├── 插件配置   （官方，order 0）
├── 插件列表   （官方只读清单，order 10）
└── 第三方插件 （本插件，order 20）   ← 新增

dsh-plugins-hub README · 它长什么样：Tab 顶部是 profile 概览（profile 名、第三方数、官方数、pnpm 是否可用），下面是两组可折叠的插件卡片：

- **第三方插件**（默认展开）：每张卡片显示名称、版本、`第三方/官方`、安装方式（`npm` / `git` / `本地链接` / `本地目录` / `内置`）、`bundle 层`、运行状态（`运行中` / `已停用` / `补丁停用` / `加载失败` / `未挂载`）、更新状态（`可更新 1.2.3` / `已是最新` / `本地来源` / `未检查`），以及描述、安装 spec、包目录、git 状态（分支 / 是否脏 / 落后多少提交）。
  每行的操作：`更新` 或 `拉取源码`、`启用` / `停用`、`目录`（在文件管理器里打开）、`卸载`（二次确认）。
- **官方插件**（默认折叠）：随发行版安装的那 150+ 行，只读，用来对照「哪些是自己装的」。

底部是「最近一次操作」面板，可以展开看 pnpm / git 的原始输出。

dsh-plugins-hub README · 判定规则：谁算第三方：不看包名猜，而是看**包实际落在哪里**：

| 解析结果 | 判定 |
| --- | --- |
| 落在 profile 自己的 `node_modules`（含 `link:` / `file:` 依赖，它们的软链就在那里） | 第三方 |
| 只经安装闭包 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` 解析到 | 官方 |
| 解析不到，回退 `@deepseek-ai/` 前缀启发式 | 展示用兜底 |

所以 `dsh-openspec`（`link:` 到开发目录）是第三方，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs` 是官方，`cordis:include` 这种 loader 内建归官方。

dsh-plugins-hub README · 每种来源支持什么：| 来源 | 检查更新 | 更新 | 卸载 | 启停 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `npm`（`^1.2.3`） | 对比 registry 的 `latest`，只在**严格更新**时才报「可更新」 | `pnpm add <name>@latest` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `git`（`github:owner/repo`） | `git ls-remote` 的远端 HEAD 对比 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 里记录的 commit | `pnpm add <原 spec>` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `link:` / `file:` | 不查线上版本，读取该目录的 git 状态 | 若目录是 git 仓库且工作区干净：`git pull --ff-only`；否则不可更新 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 官方内置 | — | — | ❌ | ✅（改动写入补丁层） |

「可更新」永远只代表“有更新的版本”，不会把降级说成更新（预发布版 vs 稳定版的比较走完整 semver 优先级）。

dsh-plugins-hub README · 生效时机：- **启用 / 停用**：改写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（只动目标行，注释、`!!js` 表达式、`insert:` 块里其它行都原样保留），DSH 的配置热重载会在 1~3 秒内重组插件树，**不用重启**。
- **更新 / 卸载**：等价于 `dsh plugin --profile web add|remove`，会同步 `dsh.profile.bundles`；**需要重启 `dsh web`** 才会彻底生效，Tab 里会出现提示条和「复制重启命令」。

卸载一个非 bundle 插件时，会把用户补丁层里指向它的 `insert` 行改成 `disabled: true`，避免它下次启动因为找不到包而报错。

dsh-plugins-hub README · 安全边界：- 所有宿主路由仅接受**本机回环**请求，且校验 `Host` / `Origin`；写操作还要求自定义头 `x-dsh-plugins-hub`（跨站请求会先触发预检，而本服务从不批准预检）。
- 包名、entry id 都过白名单正则；不拼 shell，全部走 `execFile` 参数数组。
- **受保护行**不能停用或卸载：热重载链（`cordis-plugin-timer` / `cordis-plugin-hmr`）、Web 服务链（`dsh-host-webserver` / `dsh-web-app` / `dsh-client-modules` / `dsh-client-connection` / `dsh-api-remotes`）、设置面板本身，以及本插件自己。
- 官方内置插件不能被卸载，只能停用。
dsh-plugins-hub README · 安装：```bash
dsh-plugins-hub README · 装进 web profile（会同时登记到 dsh.profile.bundles）：dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-plugins-hub

dsh-plugins-hub README · 结构：```
src/index.ts         宿主插件：路由、清单组装、更新检查、pnpm/git 变更、补丁启停
src/profile.ts       profile 定位、原子写、pnpm 运行器、bundle 列表 reconcile
src/classify.ts      官方/第三方判定与包解析
src/updates.ts       registry / git 更新检测、semver 比较、checkout 的 git 事实

宿主半边不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，全部按鸭子类型消费（`loader.entries()`、`webServer.register`），因此不需要 peer 依赖闭包，也能跨 DSH 版本继续加载。

dsh-plugins-hub README · 参考：- [fazhu4/dsh-plugin-studio](https://github.com/fazhu4/dsh-plugin-studio)：在 `settings.plugins.tab` 里做官方/社区分组、补丁层启停、受保护行名单。
- [HTUP1/dsh-plugin-manager](https://github.com/HTUP1/dsh-plugin-manager)：`settings.section` 版本的管理页、卸载失败降级、中间态提示。
- [dsh-market/dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)：pnpm 兼容层、更新检测（npm dist-tag / git HEAD）、失败分类、重启语义。
- 官方包本身就是契约：`dsh-client-ui-settings-plugins`（`settings.plugins.tab` 插槽）、`dsh-host-plugin-inventory`、`dsh-client-connection`、`dsh-app-boot`（profile/bundle）、`dsh plugin` CLI。

dsh-plugins-hub README · dsh-plugins-hub：Separates **official** plugins from **third-party** ones inside **Settings → Plugins**, and manages the third-party half: check for updates, update, uninstall, enable/disable.

```
Settings → Plugins
├── Configurable  (shipped, order 0)
├── All           (shipped read-only inventory, order 10)
└── Third-party   (this plugin, order 20)   ← new
dsh-plugins-hub README · What it looks like：The tab opens on a profile summary (profile name, third-party count, official count, whether pnpm is available) above two collapsible groups:

dsh-plugins-hub README · What it looks like：- **Third-party** (expanded by default): each card shows name, version, `Official`/`Third-party`, how it is installed (`npm` / `git` / `local link` / `local dir` / `built-in`), whether it is a `bundle layer`, its runtime state (`Running` / `Disabled` / `Patch-disabled` / `Failed to load` / `Not mounted`), its freshness (`Update 1.2.3` / `Up to date` / `Local source` / `Not checked`), plus description, install spec, package directory, and git facts (branch, dirty, commits behind).
  Row actions: `Update` or `Pull source`, `Enable`/`Disable`, `Folder` (reveal in the file manager), `Uninstall` (two-step confirm).
- **Official** (collapsed by default): the 150+ rows the release ships, read-only, as the contrast to what you installed yourself.
dsh-plugins-hub README · What it looks like：A "last operation" panel at the bottom expands to the raw pnpm/git output.

dsh-plugins-hub README · How official vs third-party is decided：Not by package name — by where the package actually lives:

| Resolution | Verdict |
| --- | --- |
| Inside the profile's own `node_modules` (including `link:` / `file:` dependencies, whose symlink lives there) | third-party |
| Resolvable only through the installation closure `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` | official |
| Unresolvable — falls back to the `@deepseek-ai/` scope heuristic | display convenience only |
section: How official vs third-party is decided

text: dsh-plugins-hub README · How official vs third-party is decided：So `dsh-openspec` (a `link:` into a checkout) is third-party, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs` is official, and loader built-ins such as `cordis:include` are official.

text:
dsh-plugins-hub README · What each source supports：| Source | Check | Update | Uninstall | Enable/disable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `npm` (`^1.2.3`) | compares the registry's `latest`, reports an update only for a strictly newer release | `pnpm add <name>@latest` | yes | yes |
| `git` (`github:owner/repo`) | the remote head from `git ls-remote` against the commit recorded in `pnpm-lock.yaml` | `pnpm add <original spec>` | yes | yes |
| `link:` / `file:` | no upstream version; reads the checkout's git state instead | `git pull --ff-only` when it is a clean git worktree | yes | yes |
| Shipped in-box | — | — | no | yes (writes the patch layer) |

dsh-plugins-hub README · What each source supports："Update available" only ever means a newer version exists — a downgrade is never advertised, and prerelease-vs-stable comparisons use full semver precedence.

dsh-plugins-hub README · When changes take effect：- **Enable / disable** rewrites the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, touching only the target row's `disabled:` line (comments, `!!js` expressions, and sibling rows inside an `insert:` block survive byte for byte). DSH's live config reload recomposes the tree within a second or two — **no restart**.
- **Update / uninstall** are the same operations as `dsh plugin --profile web add|remove`, including `dsh.profile.bundles` reconciliation, and **require a `dsh web` restart** to fully apply. The tab says so and offers to copy the restart command.

dsh-plugins-hub README · When changes take effect：Uninstalling a non-bundle plugin also flips the user-patch `insert` row that pointed at it to `disabled: true`, so the next boot cannot fail on a package that no longer exists.

dsh-plugins-hub README · Safety boundary：- Every host route accepts loopback requests only, and validates `Host` / `Origin`; mutations additionally require an `x-dsh-plugins-hub` header (a cross-site caller would need a CORS preflight this server never approves).
- Package names and entry ids are whitelist-validated; nothing is concatenated into a shell — everything runs through `execFile` argument arrays.
- **Protected rows** cannot be disabled or uninstalled: the hot-reload chain (`cordis-plugin-timer`, `cordis-plugin-hmr`), the web serving chain (`dsh-host-webserver`, `dsh-web-app`, `dsh-client-modules`, `dsh-client-connection`, `dsh-api-remotes`), the settings shell, and this plugin itself.
- Shipped plugins cannot be uninstalled — only disabled.

dsh-plugins-hub README · Layout：```
src/index.ts         host plugin: routes, list assembly, update checks, pnpm/git mutations, patch toggles
src/profile.ts       profile discovery, atomic writes, pnpm runner, bundle reconciliation
src/classify.ts      official/third-party classification and package resolution

dsh-plugins-hub README · Layout：The host half imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package; it consumes the harness structurally (`loader.entries()`, `webServer.register`), so it needs no peer closure and keeps loading across harness versions.

dsh-plugins-hub README · Prior art：- [fazhu4/dsh-plugin-studio](https://github.com/fazhu4/dsh-plugin-studio) — official/community grouping inside `settings.plugins.tab`, patch-layer toggles, protected rows.
- [HTUP1/dsh-plugin-manager](https://github.com/HTUP1/dsh-plugin-manager) — a `settings.section` manager, uninstall fallbacks, intermediate-state reporting.
- [dsh-market/dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) — pnpm compatibility, update detection (npm dist-tag / git HEAD), failure classification, restart semantics.
- The shipped packages are the contract: `dsh-client-ui-settings-plugins` (`settings.plugins.tab`), `dsh-host-plugin-inventory`, `dsh-client-connection`, `dsh-app-boot`, and the `dsh plugin` CLI.
